verdict.rationale: Docs describe delegating complex multi-step work to Computer, which then browses, runs code, sends email, and manages tasks. They also describe a conversational loop where Computer asks for more information, the user answers, sensitive actions get approve/deny prompts, and sessions continue on a thread. Together this indicates the product is operated through natural-language task instructions, and a runtime probe confirms the hosted endpoint is live. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that tasks are phrased as natural-language prompts (including prompt examples), and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation quality in the consumer UI.
